scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 18 boards of nine live Deity Science (Online) games of 2026-11-05/06, each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn with Rocketry known and von Braun, Kwolek, Korolev or Sagan on the host's screen within 720 points. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 5becb1cea with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with space-people-call-the-projects. Orders differ in 10/18 reads and the claim ('runs <project> for <person>') is journaled in 10/18 on arms and 0/18 off arms. Claims went ahead of Neighborhoods, empty queues, Observation Balloons and routine buildings; never Campus or Plaza work, power, the Spaceport or a Builder. The eight that do not fire: two are Recovery turns (10 of 266 plan-labelled turns past t150); on the others every eligible head is such protected work, or a nearer call found no room. A single-frame replay shows one pass of the decider, so it cannot show the stand-off from a city that took the claim back: the unit tests carry that.
